intro.texto: We will run the Section 7 tests with the Fluke 1662 — a step that is essential to the safety of the installation: it confirms grounding continuity, insulation, polarity and automatic disconnection (RCD) before handover.
intro.dica: We start with the receptacles (point by point). Once that stage is organized, we move on to the tests at the electrical panel.

captura.ajuda: Frame the scene in the camera and capture — the pose (position + target) is copied; send it to me and I will save it as the initial view.

laudo.aprovadoSub: All tests met the criteria of NBR 5410 — Section 7.
laudo.reprovadoSub: Some tests are outside the criteria — correct and retest before energizing.
laudo.andamentoSub: {{feitos}} of {{total}} tests completed. Complete the rest for the final assessment.
laudo.rodape: Training document — SimuPower · does not replace a report by a qualified professional.

veredito.polaridade-invertida: Line and neutral reversed at the receptacle.
veredito.zs-ok: Low Zs — disconnection ensured within the required time (≤0.4 s).
veredito.zs-alta: High Zs — may not disconnect within the required time.
veredito.dr-nao-disparou: RCD did not trip in time — replace.
veredito.re-ok: RE compatible with the grounding system and RCD.
veredito.re-alta: High RE — review the grounding grid.

continuidade.descricao: Verify the continuity of the protective conductor (PE) and of the equipotential bonding connections between the panelboard and each receptacle.
continuidade.criterio: Low resistance, continuous conductor (typically < 1–2 Ω depending on length/cross-section).

isolamento.descricao: Measure the insulation resistance between live conductors and between live conductors and ground, with the installation de-energized.
isolamento.parametro: Test voltage 500 V DC (circuits up to 500 V)
isolamento.criterio: R_iso ≥ 1.0 MΩ (up to 500 V). SELV/PELV: 250 V, ≥ 0.5 MΩ. Above 500 V: 1000 V, ≥ 1.0 MΩ.

polaridade.descricao: Confirm line, neutral and ground on the correct receptacle terminals (line not reversed, PE present).
polaridade.criterio: Line and neutral on the correct terminals; PE present; voltage within the nominal range.

loop-zs.descricao: Measure the line-to-ground fault loop impedance (Zs) at the receptacle and calculate the prospective fault current, to confirm disconnection within the required time.
loop-zs.parametro: No-trip mode (does not trip the RCD)
loop-zs.criterio: Zs × Ia ≤ U0: the fault current must operate the protective device within the time of Table 24/25 (TN ≤ 0.4 s on final circuits).

rcd-tempo.descricao: Apply the rated residual current (IΔn) and its multiples (×½, ×1, ×5) to measure the operating time of the RCD protecting the receptacle.

rcd-rampa.descricao: Ramp up the residual current until the RCD operates, measuring the actual trip current.
rcd-rampa.criterio: Trip between 50% and 100% of IΔn (15–30 mA for a 30 mA RCD).

aterramento.descricao: Measure the grounding electrode resistance by the loop method (no stakes), from a receptacle.
aterramento.criterio: Compatible with the grounding system and the RCD (e.g., TT: RA × IΔn ≤ 50 V).
